# DesignFoundation

> Production-grade SwiftUI component library and design system for iOS, macOS, and visionOS — free, open-source (MIT), distributed via Swift Package Manager.

DesignFoundation gives Swift developers a token-based theming engine, 25 accessible SwiftUI components plus 6 feedback/overlay modifiers (alert, toast, modal, sheet, popover, tooltip), five opinionated visual identity presets (Slate, Aurora, Copper, Sage, Garnet), Liquid Glass support for iOS 26 / macOS 26, and full Swift 6 concurrency safety — all in a single SPM dependency.

All components handle platform differences internally. Consumers do not need `#if os(macOS)` or `#if os(iOS)` guards to use DesignFoundation components — platform adaptation is automatic.

## Documentation

- [Component Library & Design System](https://nerdsnipe-inc.github.io/design-foundation/): Full documentation — installation, theming, all components, style system, platform support.
- [Integration Guide](https://nerdsnipe-inc.github.io/design-foundation/integration/): Five-step workflow for DesignFoundation + Pro — theme → shell → block → screen → your data. Target: first custom screen in under 15 minutes.
- [The Foundation Way](https://nerdsnipe-inc.github.io/design-foundation/foundation-way/): Side-by-side line-count comparisons — hand-rolled SwiftUI vs composing the packages. Promo for less code in your repo and fewer AI coding tokens.
- [Use Cases](https://nerdsnipe-inc.github.io/design-foundation/use-cases/): Who builds what — consumer social, SaaS, AI chat, notes, ecommerce, analytics, onboarding, PM, settings, and ops apps. Recommended roots and blocks per domain.
- [SwiftUI Theme Presets](https://nerdsnipe-inc.github.io/design-foundation/theme-presets/): The four built-in visual identity presets: Slate (navy-slate professional), Aurora (electric violet creative), Copper (warm amber editorial), Sage (deep green calm). Each preset auto-switches light/dark.
- [DesignFoundation Pro — Screens & Blocks](https://nerdsnipe-inc.github.io/design-foundation/pro/): Paid commercial add-on (licensed private repository). 47 full SwiftUI screens across 9 verticals + 29 UI blocks + 18 shell layouts + 9 wired composition examples. Fully themeable, Swift 6, iOS 18+. One-time purchase from $149.

## Popups & Toasts

Free (DesignFoundation 1.7.0). Docs with real recordings: https://nerdsnipe-inc.github.io/design-foundation/#popups . Clip index (file, what it shows, demo id, API): https://nerdsnipe-inc.github.io/design-foundation/videos/popups/MANIFEST.md . All clips are screen recordings of the DFPlayground Popup Lab on iOS 26.

- `.dfPopup(isPresented:configuration:onDismiss:content:)` and `.dfPopup(item:configuration:onDismiss:content:)` (item is Identifiable): one engine for centered cards, edge-flush toasts, inset floaters and bottom sheets.
- `DFPopupConfiguration(kind:position:transition:animation:autoDismissAfter:dismissOnTap:dismissOnOutsideTap:dismissOnDrag:dimsBackground:backdrop:)`; presets `.centered`, `.toast(position:autoDismissAfter:dismissOnDrag:)`, `.floater(position:autoDismissAfter:dismissOnDrag:)`, `.sheet(dismissOnDrag:backdrop:dismissOnOutsideTap:)`.
- `DFPopupKind` (.center .toast .floater .sheet); `DFPopupPosition` (.topLeading .top .topTrailing .leading .center .trailing .bottomLeading .bottom .bottomTrailing); `DFPopupTransition` (.automatic .slide .scale .fade .none .asymmetric(insert:remove:)); `DFPopupBackdrop` (.none .dim .blur; a non-nil `backdrop` wins over `dimsBackground`).
- Surface styles via `.dfPopupStyle(_:)`: .standard .frosted .glass (iOS/macOS 26) .accent .gradient .inverse .outlined .tinted(_: DFToastSeverity). Colored styles resolve AA-contrast foregrounds.
- Cards: `DFPopupCard(icon:iconTint:title:message:alignment:primaryAction:secondaryAction:tertiaryAction:onClose:)` (also with `media:` and `content:` builders), `DFPopupHeader`, `DFPopupActions`, `DFPopupIconBadge`, `DFPopupAction(_:role:action:)`.
- Toasts: `DFToastQueue.shared.show(text:icon:duration:severity:position:title:actionTitle:action:)` + `.dfToast()`; severities info/success/warning/error; styles via `.dfToastStyle(_:)`: .default .tinted .filled .inverse .frosted .glass (26+) .banner .compact. Style with `.dfToast(style: .tinted)`; `.dfToast().dfToastStyle(_:)` also works, but `.dfToastStyle(_:).dfToast()` does not restyle toasts.
- Tokens: `theme.components.popup = DFPopupTokens(cornerRadius:padding:maxWidth:backdropOpacity:)`; `DFPopupHost` embeds the layer in custom containers.

Pro (DesignFoundationPro 2.3.0, requires DesignFoundation 1.7.0). Docs: https://nerdsnipe-inc.github.io/design-foundation/pro/#popups

- `.dfPopupPresentation(isPresented:display:configuration:keyboard:scrim:motion:pausesOnHold:chrome:haptic:onDismiss:content:)`; display `.overlay | .sheet | .window`; keyboard `.avoid | .ignore`; `DFPopupScrim` `.dim(_:) .blur(_:) .custom{} .clear .passingTouches()`; `DFPopupDismissReason` `.timeout .tap .outsideTap .drag .programmatic .preempted`; `@Environment(\.dfPopupDismiss)`; `dfPopupWindow` shorthand.
- `dfScrollPopup(isPresented:edge:detents:headerStyle:scrim:onDismiss:header:content:footer:)`, `fromTop:`; detents `.medium .large .fraction .height`; header styles `.plain .centered .prominent .closable`.
- `DFPopupCenter` + `.dfPopupCenter(_:)`, `present(id:priority:configuration:haptic:onDismiss:content:)`, `dismiss(id:)`; `DFPopupPriority` `.low .normal .high .critical`; preemption and id de-duplication.
- Rich popups: `.dfCelebrationPopup`, `.dfPermissionPrompt` (`DFPermissionKind`), `.dfPromoPopup`, `.dfRatingPrompt`, `.dfInputPopup`, `.dfConsentSheet`, `.dfActionPopup`.
- Toasts and status: `.dfUndoToast(indicator: .ring | .bar)`, `.dfProgressToast(state: .progress | .success | .failure)`, `.dfNotificationBanners(items:)`, `.dfLiveCapsule`.
- Coachmarks: `DFCoachmarkTour`, `.dfCoachmarkTour(_:spotlight:)`, `.dfCoachmark`, `.dfPopupAnchor(_:)`.
- Motion: `DFPopupMotion` `.snappy .bouncy .gentle .zoom .zoomOut .drop .slideFade .elastic .custom`, `.motion(_:enterFrom:exitTo:)`; `DFPopupCountdownBar`, `DFPopupCountdownRing`, `DFPopupHaptic`.

## Source

- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/NerdSnipe-Inc/design-foundation): Source code, releases, issues, and Swift Package Manager URL.
- [Latest Release — v1.1.0](https://github.com/NerdSnipe-Inc/design-foundation/releases/tag/v1.1.0): Release notes for v1.1.0 (preset themes, resolve(for:) API, macOS token fixes, semantic typography).

## AI Agent Guidance

DesignFoundation ships agent instruction files to help AI coding assistants use the package correctly:
- `CLAUDE.md` / `AGENTS.md` — Claude Code and OpenAI Codex instructions in both packages
- `.cursor/rules/design-foundation.mdc` and `.cursor/rules/design-foundation-pro.mdc` — Cursor rules for teams **using** the packages

The core rule in all files: never build UI that DesignFoundation or DesignFoundationPro already provides.

## Key Facts

- **License:** MIT (free for personal and commercial use)
- **SPM URL:** https://github.com/NerdSnipe-Inc/design-foundation
- **Current version:** 1.1.0
- **DesignFoundation Pro:** Commercial license — private GitHub access after purchase (not a public repository)
- **Platforms:** iOS 18.0+, macOS 15.0+, visionOS 2.0+
- **Swift version:** Swift 6 (strict concurrency enabled)
- **Cross-platform:** All components adapt internally — no `#if os()` guards needed in consuming code
- **Components:** DFButton, DFBadge, DFAvatar, DFCard, DFTextField, DFSecureField, DFValidatedTextField, DFToggle, DFSlider, DFPicker, DFDatePicker, DFCheckbox, DFModal, DFSheet, DFPopover, DFTooltip, DFTabBar, DFNavigationBar, DFSidebar, DFToast, DFSkeleton, DFProgressBar, DFList, DFListRow, DFTable, DFDataTable, DFDataGrid, DFDivider, DFText, DFIcon, DFAlert
- **Validation:** DFValidatedTextField with DFFieldValidator (rules: .email, .minLength, .required, .custom) and DFFormState for multi-field form management
- **Theming:** DFTheme struct injected via .dfTheme() modifier; preset themes via .dfThemePreset(); all tokens (colors, typography, spacing, radius, shadow, animation) are overridable
- **Preset themes:** .slate, .aurora, .copper, .sage, .garnet — each ships light + dark DFTheme, apply with MyApp().dfThemePreset(.slate)
- **Liquid Glass:** .glass styles on buttons, cards, badges, avatars, modals, sheets, popovers, tooltips, sidebar, tab bar — requires iOS 26+ / macOS 26+
